RULE-001.title: Online booking price is the sum of selected treatment prices

RULE-002.title: Online booking end = start + summed duration, in server-local time

RULE-003.title: Server accepts the browser's price and duration unchecked

RULE-006.title: Calendar entries and online requests store time differently
RULE-006.note: Should be unified: one time-storage form (chosen option).

RULE-012.title: Treatment prices and durations are fixed in the browser

RULE-017.title: Online booking window: today to the same day next month, weekdays only

RULE-019.title: Online start time 12:00–20:45 on quarter hours (UI offers only to 20:00)
RULE-019.note: Last online start should match the UI (20:00) and/or the booking must end by closing time (chosen option).

RULE-021.title: Phone must be a Serbian mobile or international number, max 16 characters
RULE-021.note: Server regex should be anchored like the browser regex (chosen option).

RULE-023.title: Admin entry: 11:00–22:00, 15-minute grid, at most 4 hours
RULE-023.note: Sundays / non-working days should be blocked for admin entries (chosen option).

RULE-030.title: Captcha verdict: rejected only if the token is invalid AND the score < 0.25
RULE-030.note: Confirmed as current behavior. Conflicts with the pending security patch SEC-001 (OR logic + server-side action): resolve before brief.

RULE-031.title: Admin login: password-hash check, audit on success and failure

RULE-033.title: Slot conflict: no overlap, back-to-back allowed (admin entries only)

RULE-036.title: Returning client matched only when both email and phone match

RULE-037.title: Decision link: anonymous GET, date taken from the query, fixed Serbian redirects

RULE-038.title: JWT: signed, bound to issuer and audience, expires after configured minutes

RULE-039.title: Client and calendar APIs accept any logged-in user (no roles)

RULE-041.title: Admin user creation exists only in DEBUG builds

RULE-046.title: A booking is saved only if both notification emails are sent
RULE-046.note: Email order / atomicity of the booking save should change (chosen option).

RULE-050.title: Placing an online request on the calendar keeps its status

RULE-054.title: Deleting a calendar entry hard-deletes its appointment silently

RULE-056.title: Saving the client card marks history visits Performed and deletes other appointments
